title: Childcare, daycare, or preschool vetting
description: Vet a candidate childcare provider, daycare, or preschool on licensing, safety record, and reviews before a parent decides to enroll.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: childcare-vetting
  title: Childcare, daycare, or preschool vetting
  description: Vet a candidate childcare provider, daycare, or preschool on licensing, safety record, and reviews before a parent decides to enroll.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Give a parent a clear, balanced picture of a candidate childcare provider's licensing, safety record, and reputation, culminating in explicit parent sign-off before enrollment.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [childcare-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Candidate provider details
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The name, location, and any known details of the candidate childcare provider, daycare, or preschool. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: licensing-verifier
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Licensing and safety-record verifier
      role: Careful researcher of public licensing status and safety records for childcare providers.
      prompt: Research the candidate provider's licensing status and any publicly available safety-record or inspection history. Present findings as general, publicly available information only; this workflow does not provide legal or medical advice, does not diagnose, and does not recommend any medication or treatment. Note that the parent should verify current licensing directly with the relevant state or local licensing authority before enrolling.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: review-reader
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Review-sentiment reader
      role: Balanced reader of publicly available parent reviews and reputation signals.
      prompt: Research publicly available parent reviews and reputation signals for the candidate provider, summarizing common themes rather than relying on any single review. This is general reputation information only, not professional advice, and does not diagnose or recommend any treatment. Note that individual reviews can be biased or outdated and should be weighed alongside a personal visit.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: vetting-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel provider vetting
      config: { members: [licensing-verifier, review-reader], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: vote-findings
      kind: aggregator
      name: Vote-combine vetting findings
      config: { aggregation: vote }
    - id: assess-fit
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Overall suitability assessor
      role: Neutral assessor combining licensing, safety, and reputation findings into an overall suitability read.
      prompt: Combine the licensing, safety-record, and reputation findings into an overall suitability assessment for the candidate provider. This is general informational guidance only, not legal or medical advice, and does not diagnose or recommend any treatment or medication. Clearly state that this assessment is not a substitute for the parent's own visit, judgment, and any needed professional consultation.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [score, passed, reasons]
        properties:
          score: { type: number }
          passed: { type: boolean }
          reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: childcare-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Parent sign-off before enrolling
      summary: The parent reviews the assessment and explicitly approves before any enrollment step proceeds.
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Vetting summary and enrollment decision
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: vetting-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: vetting-group, to: vote-findings, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: vote-findings, to: assess-fit, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: assess-fit, to: childcare-approval, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: childcare-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
